why.en: "Would" never goes inside the if-clause. The second conditional if-clause uses the past simple: "If I had..."
why.bn: "Would" কখনো if-clause-এর ভিতরে বসে না। Second conditional-এর if-clause-এ past simple লাগে: "If I had..."

why.en: A past unreal condition ("had taken") combined with a present-day result ("would be living... now") is a mixed conditional.
